_comment: Tier-2: a Neumann heat flux goes on FACE_HEAT_FLUX, not on TEMPERATURE; targeting TEMPERATURE applies a Dirichlet pseudo-flux. Pitfall (kratos.heat #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). FACE_HEAT_FLUX resolves on core KratosMultiphysics and NOT on ConvectionDiffusionApplication (the module a reader would reach for), and KM.ApplyConstantScalarValueProcess — the process the claim names — exists. The wrong target, TEMPERATURE, is also a valid variable, which is why the mistake is silent rather than raising. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
